1981-2415-5933-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-5933-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2981-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2981-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3699-6791.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
3259-3699-6791.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

670-1619-3742-6140.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6140.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Cloister Gargoyle until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Cloister Gargoyle to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Cloister Gargoyle enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Cloister Gargoyle trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Cloister Gargoyle until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

5231-7430--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gorma.
Resolve the persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.
5231-7430--5.notes: Each loop, Gorma will place an additional +1/+1 counter on the persist creature compared to the previous loop. This'll eventually result in both the persist creature and Gorma having infinite +1/+1 counters on them.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3019-4485.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration
1618-2440-3019-4485.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3019-4485.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

2539-3094-4659-6965-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-6965-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-4785-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-4785-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

560-4550-5231-7256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-5231-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Warhost's Frenzy triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat from step 2

1322-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
1322-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6835-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2034-3490-7135.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Super Shredder triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

4050-5571-7046--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3062-4499-7009.manaNeeded: {3} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3062-4499-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Pir.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1414-2866-4779-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2232-2792-5256-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-2792-5256-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4927-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
4927-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
4927-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

2084-2959.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2084-2959.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

5010-6185-6280.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in hand.
5010-6185-6280.description:
Activate Golgari Thug's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it, causing you to mill a number of cards and return Golgari Thug from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability.
Repeat.

225-575-1184-2482.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Kin-Tree Warden.
When Kin-Tree Warden dies, Yedora triggers, returning Kin-Tree Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Kin-Tree Warden enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Kin-Tree Warden.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.

282-1326-4705-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Lightning Runner.
282-1326-4705-4918.description:
Declare Delina and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering Delina twice and Lightning Runner once.
Resolve a Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Sage of Shaila's Claim that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When the Sage of Shaila's Claim token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 2 for the remaining Delina trigger.
Resolve the Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite {E}, you may target any other creature(s) you control.

560-1339-2034-5185.description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste and two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects and Soldiers, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

841-3585-4050-4544.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-3585-4050-4544.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Greensleeves.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the Badger token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Badger, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Greensleeves trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

1651-2003-2633-4659.notablePrerequisites: You've cast three or more instants and/or sorceries this turn.
1651-2003-2633-4659.description:
Activate Urabrask by paying {R}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Work.
As The Great Work enters the battlefield, a lore counter is placed on it.
The Great Work triggers, dealing three damage to an opponent and each creature they control.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two lore counters on The Great Work.
The Great Work's second and third abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Great Work trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the second Great Work trigger, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from graveyards this turn, and then exiling The Great Work and returning it to the battlefield as Urabrask.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Contagion Engine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the two tapped Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate the final Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

927-4272.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Emperor Crocodile to an opponent who controls no creatures.
When Emperor Crocodile's controller controls no other creatures, Emperor Crocodile triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Emperor Crocodile cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Emperor Crocodile triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

1316-1651-4050-4840.notablePrerequisites: Vat of Rebirth has at least four oil counters on it.
1316-1651-4050-4840.description:
Activate Vat of Rebirth by paying {2}{B}, tapping it and removing four oil counters from it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Myrs, untapping Vat of Rebirth.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and three Myr tokens, adding {3}{B}.
Myr Battlesphere and the Myrs die, triggering Vat of Rebirth four times, putting four oil counters on it.
Repeat.

1572-2341-4067.notablePrerequisites: Two Rat creature cards in hand and/or graveyard.
1572-2341-4067.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Ashcoat of the Shadow Swarm triggers.
In response, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Ashcoat of the Shadow Swarm's triggered ability.
Resolve the copied ability, milling four cards and returning up to two Rat creature cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter twice by discarding two Rat creature cards, untapping a land and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Activate that land by tapping it to add {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-1926-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Insect.
"Insect" chosen with Species Specialist.
1339-1926-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Insect.
The Insect dies, triggering Species Specialist, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Insect's power.
Repeat.

406-3442-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Tandem Lookout paired with Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
406-3442-4869.description:
Activate Patchwork Gnomes by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Tandem Lookout triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.
Repeat.

730-1479-3861.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-1479-3861.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Emeria Angel, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Emeria Angel trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1232-4474-4893-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
1232-4474-4893-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Saproling token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
